gloss: When improvement stalls under one method, change the method instead of repeating it
mechanism: Improvement under a method is tracked per attempt. When it stalls for a stated number of attempts, the plateau is recorded with the method that hit it, and the next attempt uses a changed method. Unlike a {{retry}}, which repeats the attempt, the response to a plateau is a different way of trying.
invariants: After the stated number of stalled attempts, the next attempt uses a changed method.
Each plateau is recorded with the method that hit it.
failure_modes: Grind: the same method is repeated long after it stopped improving anything.
Method churn: methods are changed before they have had a fair number of attempts.
